title: CRITICAL: real Flash 8 FLA import — extract actual document content (0107 was a stub)
description: Audit finding: task 0107 'real FLA import' is marked done but packages/core/src/fla/ole.ts parseFlash8Stream() only pattern-scans for stage dimensions/fps/background color and returns a SKELETON document (one empty layer) — no shapes, no symbols, no timelines, no frames, no scripts are extracted. The OLE2/CFB container layer is solid (FAT chains, directory, stream extraction); the Flash 8 binary payload parsing was never built. This is an MVP pillar (FLA compatibility) and gates the golden FLA/SWF comparison harness. Scope: reverse-engineer / implement extraction of the Flash 8 'Contents' stream document structure — at minimum: stage properties, scene/timeline/layer/frame structure, shape geometry with fills/strokes, symbol definitions + library, instance placements with matrices, frame scripts (AS2 source). References: the FLA format is partially documented by community efforts (e.g. OpenFLA/libflash research); cross-check anything ambiguous against real fixtures. Acceptance: import a real Flash 8-authored .fla fixture and assert the deserialized document model contains its actual layers/shapes/symbols/scripts (not a skeleton); fixture committed under a fixtures/ dir. Be honest about unsupported corners — partial extraction with explicit warnings beats silent skeletons.
